headline: Late goal: Brazil edge Japan 2-1 to reach World Cup round of 16
summary: Gabriel Martinelli scored a dramatic stoppage-time winner to save the five-time world champions from a potential upset.
details: Brazil advanced to the World Cup round of 16 after a tense 2-1 victory over Japan. Gabriel Martinelli secured the win with a sharp finish deep in stoppage time, rescuing Brazil from a potential exit.
Japan took a surprising lead in the 29th minute when Kaishu Sano intercepted a misplaced pass from Danilo and fired a shot past goalkeeper Alisson Becker.
The Japanese side delivered a defensive masterclass in the first half, frustrating the Brazilian attack and closing down space effectively.
Brazil improved their urgency after halftime. Casemiro equalized in the 56th minute with a far-post header following a cross from Gabriel Magalhaes.
Despite a brilliant save from Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki on a Vinicius Jr shot, Brazil continued to push for a winner until Martinelli's late strike.
Brazil will now face either Norway or Ivory Coast in New Jersey on July 5.
caption:
A stoppage-time thriller! Brazil survives a Japan scare to advance.

Brazil advanced to the World Cup round of 16 after a tense 2-1 victory over Japan. Gabriel Martinelli secured the win with a sharp finish deep in stoppage time, rescuing Brazil from a potential exit.

Japan took a surprising lead in the 29th minute when Kaishu Sano intercepted a misplaced pass from Danilo and fired a shot past goalkeeper Alisson Becker.

The Japanese side delivered a defensive masterclass in the first half, frustrating the Brazilian attack and closing down space effectively.

Brazil improved their urgency after halftime. Casemiro equalized in the 56th minute with a far-post header following a cross from Gabriel Magalhaes.

Despite a brilliant save from Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki on a Vinicius Jr shot, Brazil continued to push for a winner until Martinelli's late strike.

Brazil will now face either Norway or Ivory Coast in New Jersey on July 5.

headline: Dipu Moni taken to Dhaka Medical College Hospital after falling ill in prison
summary: The former minister was rushed to the hospital for urgent medical attention after her health deteriorated suddenly while in custody.
details: Former minister Dipu Moni has been shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) after suddenly falling ill while in prison.
The medical emergency occurred while she was in custody, prompting authorities to move her to the hospital for necessary treatment.
She is currently receiving medical care at the hospital under the supervision of prison and security personnel.
